Khazix.escape: Kha'Zix E Leap is his only mobility spell, so its use to engage creates an opening for Wukong. Close the gap with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and Wukong W Warrior Trickster, then use Wukong R Cyclone to keep Kha'Zix from escaping. If Kha'Zix E Leap has evolved, a takedown can reset its cooldown, so don't try to retaliate after an ally is picked off.
Khazix.build: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear, Kha'Zix W Void Spike, and Kha'Zix E Leap deal physical damage, so build armor first. Remember that Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat's bonus damage is magic damage and cannot be blocked with armor.
Khazix.combo: When Kha'Zix E Leap is down, press Wukong Q Crushing Blow while dashing in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike so your empowered attack lands as soon as you arrive. Then knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone and immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics R Cyclone. While invisible, Wukong can dodge Kha'Zix's counterattack and reposition.
Khazix.fight: Don't use Wukong E Nimbus Strike first while Kha'Zix E Leap is available. Immediately after Kha'Zix leaps in, knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone, then keep attacking with Wukong Q Crushing Blow's empowered attack and the attack speed from Wukong E Nimbus Strike. If you can hit a jungle monster before the fight, build stacks of Wukong P Stone Skin.
Khazix.laning: Don't let Kha'Zix figure out where you are clearing camps alone, and secure vision in river and jungle entrance bushes as you move. Keep clearing camps to maintain Wukong P Stone Skin stacks, and save Wukong R Cyclone for the next fight. Look for an early gank, but go in after Kha'Zix E Leap is down.
Khazix.phase: In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone instead of dealing damage alone.
Khazix.teamfight: Group with allies in a narrow area where you have vision to prevent the isolated damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. If Kha'Zix uses Kha'Zix E Leap to dive onto an ally behind you, knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone. If he disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, wait near your allies for him to reappear, then use Wukong E Nimbus Strike and Wukong R Cyclone to knock up enemies when two or more are grouped together.
Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals much more damage when you are isolated, so fight near allies or minions. When Kha'Zix is out of sight, Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat empowers his next basic attack with bonus magic damage and a slow, so secure vision in bushes. If Kha'Zix disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, stay close to your allies and knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone as soon as he reappears.

Ekko.phase: Early on, Wukong's clear speed and damage are average, and he is vulnerable to magic damage, so fight Ekko carefully and look for early ganks. In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Ekko.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Ekko's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and prioritize building magic resistance.
Ekko.combo: When Ekko's escape is down, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike while pressing Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash. Land the empowered basic attack as soon as you arrive, knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone, then follow up with Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone also uses R Cyclone.
Ekko.escape: Dodge the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence, then look for an angle to engage. If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, he can still escape with R Chronobreak, so close the gap with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and use Wukong R Cyclone especially while Ekko R Chronobreak is down.
Ekko.fight: Dodge the area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence, then engage after Ekko E Phase Dive and R Chronobreak are down. As you engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike, activate Wukong Q Crushing Blow in advance, then follow up with the empowered basic attack and regular attacks when you arrive.
Ekko.laning: Early on, watch out for Ekko's magic damage and look for an advantage with early ganks instead of taking reckless fights. Keep clearing jungle camps in sequence to maintain Wukong P Stone Skin stacks, and save Wukong R Cyclone for fights rather than clearing.
Ekko.teamfight: Dodge the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence and time your engage with allied crowd control. Right after Ekko engages with E Phase Dive, look for a chance to knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone to force out R Chronobreak or lock him down. If two or more enemies are grouped, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike, use Wukong R Cyclone, then follow up with Wukong W Warrior Trickster to continue R Cyclone.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. Step aside from Ekko Q Timewinder's return path, and do not overchase even a low-health Ekko if you see the afterimage from R Chronobreak.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about relying on a large health increase alone. Don't spend resources on magic resistance just to face Poppy.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and activate Wukong Q Crushing Blow in advance. Land your empowered attack as soon as you arrive, avoid the crowd control from Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict, then use Wukong R Cyclone. Follow with Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics your ultimate while Wukong turns invisible and avoids a counterattack.
Poppy.escape: Immediately after making Poppy use Poppy E Heroic Charge, you have a chance to close the gap. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, hold your dash until it ends or walk in. Engage with Wukong R Cyclone after Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict are down.
Poppy.fight: Close the gap after Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down. Don't stay where Poppy Q Hammer Shock's second hit will land.
Poppy.laning: Stand in open space without putting your back to a wall or narrow passage to avoid Poppy E Heroic Charge's wall collision. When the shield thrown by Poppy P Iron Ambassador lands, step on it first to deny her the shield. Save Wukong Q Crushing Blow to use against champions.
Poppy.phase: Wukong's early clear speed and damage are average, so look to gain an advantage through early ganks. In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone instead of dealing damage.
Poppy.teamfight: Wait out Poppy W Steadfast Presence, and engage after the crowd control from Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict is down. When two or more enemies group together, coordinate with your allies' crowd control, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike, and knock them up with Wukong R Cyclone. Immediately after Wukong R Cyclone, use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics your ultimate, then circle around while invisible to target the backline.
Poppy.watch: If you dash with Wukong E Nimbus Strike or Wukong W Warrior Trickster while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, it will stop you and prevent you from using mobility spells for a short time. If Poppy E Heroic Charge knocks you into a wall, you'll be stunned, so don't stand with your back to a wall. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you, leave the remaining zone immediately. When you see Poppy R Keeper's Verdict charging, dodge sideways from the front.

Lillia.fight: Close the gap after Lillia misses her skills and fails to build movement speed stacks. When Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is down, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike, then use the empowered attack on arrival and follow with more attacks to make use of the attack speed bonus. Don't automatically use Wukong W Warrior Trickster right after engaging; save it for the situation so you can evade her counterattack.
Lillia.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots early. Lillia's main damage is magic and Wukong has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Resistance does not reduce the true damage from Lillia Q Blooming Blows, and Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough deals damage based on your maximum health.
Lillia.combo: When Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is down, press Wukong Q Crushing Blow while dashing in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike so your empowered attack lands as soon as you arrive. After engaging Lillia with Wukong R Cyclone, immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics your ultimate while Wukong turns invisible and avoids her counterattack.
Lillia.escape: The moment Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is down is an opening to close the gap with Wukong W Warrior Trickster or Wukong E Nimbus Strike. If Lillia's skills have put you under Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, get to safety before falling asleep. Use Wukong R Cyclone after the enemy's main crowd control is down.
Lillia.laning: When you don't know where Lillia is, avoid taking jungle entrances and narrow river passages where it's hard to dodge Lillia E Swirlseed. Keep clearing jungle camps to maintain Wukong P Stone Skin stacks, and you can hit a nearby monster just before a fight to build them up. Save Wukong R Cyclone for fights and objective contests instead of using it to clear camps.
Lillia.phase: Early on, Wukong's clear speed is average and he is vulnerable to magic damage, so build magic resistance and look for an early gank. Take advantage of the window when Watch Out! Eep! is down. In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone instead of dealing damage.
Lillia.teamfight: Wait for an angle to use Wukong R Cyclone to catch Lillia when she approaches from the flank. When she overlaps with another enemy, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and knock them up together with Wukong R Cyclone, coordinating with your allies' crowd control. Wukong W Warrior Trickster can make the clone mimic your ultimate while Wukong circles around to reach the backline.
Lillia.watch: Getting hit by Lillia Q Blooming Blows and Lillia E Swirlseed creates the conditions for you to fall asleep from Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, so dodge them even when you have plenty of health. When you see Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!'s animation, move sideways to avoid its center. If Lillia R Lilting Lullaby affects you, move to safety while you can still move before falling asleep.

Amumu.teamfight: While Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is ready, do not stack with allies; engage after Amumu Q Bandage Toss and R are down. If two or more enemies are grouped together, follow up on allied crowd control with Wukong E Nimbus Strike, then move while spinning Wukong R Cyclone to knock them up together. Use Wukong W Warrior Trickster right away to add the clone's ultimate, then circle around and get behind them.
Amumu.combo: If Amumu's main crowd control abilities are down, press Wukong Q Crushing Blow while closing in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike so you land the empowered basic attack as soon as you arrive. Then, right after knocking him up with Wukong R Cyclone, use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics the ultimate too. Use the time you are invisible to avoid the counterattack and reposition.
Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits you, it stuns you, and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy can follow to immobilize you, so move with a minion or jungle monster between you. When Amumu has R ready, keep your distance from allies and spread out in open terrain. Amumu W Despair deals damage based on your maximum health while you are nearby, so do not stay close for long.
Amumu.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand his damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Amumu deals mostly magic damage, and Wukong has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Avoid investing heavily in health alone because of Amumu W Despair.
Amumu.escape: Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so the window to engage is when Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down. Close the gap with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and lock him down with Wukong R Cyclone. Do not use Wukong W Warrior Trickster immediately after engaging; save it to dodge a counterattack or fake your position.
Amumu.fight: Amumu E Tantrum reduces physical damage taken and comes back faster as he is hit by basic attacks, so avoid trades where you hit only Amumu for a long time. When fighting, use Wukong Q Crushing Blow to reduce his armor and focus him with allied magic damage. Engaging after Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down reduces the risk of Wukong R Cyclone being interrupted.
Amumu.laning: Amumu Q Bandage Toss stops at the first target it hits, so stand behind minions in lane and move unpredictably. While clearing jungle camps, keep your Wukong P Stone Skin stacks going and save Wukong R Cyclone for the next fight.
Amumu.phase: In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than trying to deal damage over time.

Evelynn.laning: Place a ward beside the jungle camp where Evelynn will start fighting the camp. If you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, back away immediately and alert your allies. Do not use Wukong R Cyclone to clear camps; save it for the next fight.
Evelynn.build: Evelynn's main damage is magic, and Wukong has relatively low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Evelynn W Allure reduces magic resistance, so prioritize backing away before the mark completes even if you have built resistance.
Evelynn.combo: When Evelynn's charm and mobility are down, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and activate Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash. Land the empowered basic attack as soon as you arrive, knock her up with Wukong R Cyclone, then use Wukong W Warrior Trickster right away so the clone mimics the ultimate too. While invisible, avoid Evelynn's counterattack.
Evelynn.escape: Back away before the mark from Evelynn W Allure matures, then look for an opening after the charm is down. If only Evelynn E Whiplash is down, she can still escape with Evelynn R Last Caress, so look especially for the window before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back. Then close the gap with Wukong W Warrior Trickster and Wukong E Nimbus Strike and knock her up with Wukong R Cyclone.
Evelynn.fight: Avoid the charm from Evelynn W Allure and engage after Evelynn's mobility is down. Do not use Wukong W Warrior Trickster right after engaging; save it to dodge Evelynn's counterattack.
Evelynn.phase: In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Evelynn.teamfight: Evelynn targets the backline damage dealers, so watch for her engage from a place with allied vision and knock her up with Wukong R Cyclone when she comes in. Once the charm from Evelynn W Allure is down and two or more enemies are grouped, follow up on allied crowd control with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and spin Wukong R Cyclone. If you leave the clone with Wukong W Warrior Trickster, it also mimics the ultimate while you become invisible and avoid the counterattack.
Evelynn.watch: When you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, back away before the charm completes and alert your allies. Evelynn R Last Caress deals much more damage when you are low on health, so do not stay in areas without vision.

Fiddlesticks.watch: Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm moves after channeling and deals damage in an area. If you see the cast, interrupt it with Wukong R Cyclone; if you can’t, get out of range and wait out its duration. Abilities that hit you from out of sight can cause fear, so watch out for Fiddlesticks when he hasn’t been visible for a while and for Scarecrow Effigies standing in bushes.
Fiddlesticks.build: Fiddlesticks deals mostly magic damage, and Wukong has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Get a Null-Magic Mantle early to hold on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Fiddlesticks.combo: Press Wukong Q Crushing Blow during Wukong E Nimbus Strike's dash so the empowered basic attack lands as soon as you arrive. Then use Wukong R Cyclone and immediately Wukong W Warrior Trickster; the clone will mimic the ultimate while Wukong becomes invisible and can avoid retaliation.
Fiddlesticks.escape: After Fiddlesticks Q Terrify is down, engage with Wukong R Cyclone to reduce the risk of being interrupted by crowd control.
Fiddlesticks.fight: When Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is down, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and follow up with basic attacks. Save Wukong W Warrior Trickster for dodging Fiddlesticks' retaliation rather than using it right after engaging.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Chain jungle camps to keep Wukong P Stone Skin stacks, and you can also hit a nearby jungle monster just before a fight to build stacks. Keep vision in the brush behind your lane during Fiddlesticks' ganking windows. Place Control Wards in the brush in front of objectives and along the paths leading in, and avoid objective fights if Wukong R Cyclone is not ready.
Fiddlesticks.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging to knock up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, Fiddlesticks E Reap, and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm hit in an area, so spread out from allies and do not bunch up in narrow passages where you have no vision. After Fiddlesticks Q Terrify is down and at least two enemies are grouped, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and spin Wukong R Cyclone. Coordinate your engage order with your allies' crowd control, then use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to mimic the ultimate and circle to the rear.

Nidalee.teamfight: Remember where Nidalee showed to throw her spear. When two or more enemies are grouped together, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike in sync with your team’s crowd control and cast Wukong R Cyclone. During Cyclone, move toward the grouped enemies, then use Wukong W Warrior Trickster right afterward to continue the ultimate with your clone and avoid their counterattack.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss / Takedown deals more damage the farther the spear travels, so dodge its path when Nidalee is far away. Being hit by Nidalee Q Javelin Toss / Takedown or Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce traps applies the Hunted mark, so if you’re hit by a spear, save Wukong R Cyclone for the moment Nidalee Pounces in.
Nidalee.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Since Nidalee's damage is mostly magic, building magic resistance first is effective for Wukong.
Nidalee.combo: When Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce is down, press Wukong Q Crushing Blow while dashing in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike, then land your empowered attack as soon as you arrive. After knocking her up with Wukong R Cyclone, immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics your ultimate while Wukong turns invisible and avoids her counterattack.
Nidalee.escape: Nidalee has no crowd control, so immediately after making her use Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce, you have a chance to engage. Close the gap then with Wukong W Warrior Trickster or Wukong E Nimbus Strike, and hold her in place with Wukong R Cyclone.
Nidalee.fight: Don't use Wukong E Nimbus Strike first while Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce is available. Immediately after Nidalee uses Pounce, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and press Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash so your empowered attack lands as soon as you arrive.
Nidalee.laning: Watch out for traps from Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce around jungle entrances and river, and check for them with a Control Ward or an area-of-effect skill before entering. Keep clearing camps to maintain Wukong P Stone Skin stacks, and save Wukong R Cyclone for fights instead of using it to clear.
Nidalee.phase: Early on, Wukong's clear speed is average and he is vulnerable to magic damage, so build resistance and look for an early gank. In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone instead of dealing damage.

Belveth.phase: Bel’Veth gets stronger as the game goes on, so later focus on engaging to knock up multiple enemies rather than dealing damage with Wukong.
Belveth.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. Armor won't stop the magic damage from Bel'Veth W Above and Below, and Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet's true damage is countered by total health rather than resistance.
Belveth.combo: After Bel'Veth's mobility ability and Bel'Veth W Above and Below are down, dash in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and activate Wukong Q Crushing Blow beforehand to land an empowered basic attack as you arrive. Follow with Wukong R Cyclone to knock her up, then immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone also spins the ultimate. While stealthed, Wukong can dodge Bel'Veth's retaliation and reposition.
Belveth.escape: Bel'Veth Q Void Surge has a separate cooldown for each direction, so track the direction she just dashed. Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below, then close the distance with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and land Wukong R Cyclone's knockup before Q comes back. Also watch whether Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, another mobility option, is still available.
Belveth.fight: Just before a fight, attack a jungle monster to build Wukong P Stone Skin stacks so you can fight with increased armor and healing. When Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth W Above and Below are down, use Wukong E Nimbus Strike to close in and follow with basic attacks. When Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom starts, wait for it to end or interrupt it with the knockup from Wukong R Cyclone instead of unloading your damage.
Belveth.laning: Look for gains with Wukong's early ganks, and chain camps to keep Wukong P Stone Skin stacks active. Save Wukong R Cyclone for fights and objective battles instead of using it on camps.
Belveth.teamfight: When Bel'Veth W Above and Below is down and two or more enemies group together, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike in sync with your allies' crowd control and spin Wukong R Cyclone. Immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics the ultimate and Wukong can reposition. If an ally dies and Void Coral appears, retreat before Bel'Veth can collect it, and delay the team fight while Bel'Veth's transformation is active.
Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below knocks you up and resets Bel'Veth Q Void Surge's cooldown. When Bel'Veth closes in, don't run straight back; cut to the side to dodge W. Bel'Veth takes greatly reduced damage while Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, so save high-damage abilities until it ends.

Kindred.watch: If you keep getting hit after Kindred E Mounting Dread is applied, you can take heavy damage. When marked, use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to create distance or break vision. The lower your health, the more dangerous it is, so don’t fight for long inside Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy.
Kindred.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred E Mounting Dread. If the fight goes long, consider Grievous Wounds to counter the healing from Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy and Kindred R Lamb's Respite.
Kindred.combo: When Kindred's mobility spells are down, press Wukong Q Crushing Blow while dashing in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike so your empowered attack lands as soon as you arrive. Keep attacking, then knock her up with Wukong R Cyclone and immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics R Cyclone. While invisible, Wukong can dodge Kindred's counterattack and reposition.
Kindred.escape: The opening to engage comes when both Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy are down, especially before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back up. If Kindred E Mounting Dread has marked you, first use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to create distance or break vision and avoid taking repeated hits that build up damage.
Kindred.fight: Don't rush in when only Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down; Kindred can still create distance with Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy. When both mobility options are down, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and keep attacking to use its attack speed bonus. Rather than fighting for long inside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, use Wukong R Cyclone to knock Kindred up and limit her chance to escape.
Kindred.laning: Take marked jungle camps first or secure vision nearby to slow Kindred P Mark of the Kindred's progress. Keep clearing camps to maintain Wukong P Stone Skin stacks, and look for an angle to engage before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy zone is placed if you encounter her. Save Wukong R Cyclone for the next fight instead of using it to clear camps.
Kindred.phase: Kindred is vulnerable to pressure early, so track her path with vision and contest her marked camps. In the late game, focus on limiting Kindred P Mark of the Kindred's growth and knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone.
Kindred.teamfight: When Kindred overlaps with another enemy, coordinate with your allies' crowd control and engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike, then knock them up with Wukong R Cyclone. While spinning with Wukong R Cyclone, use the movement speed bonus to move toward grouped enemies, and use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to make the clone's R Cyclone count too. When Kindred R Lamb's Respite is active, enter the zone so low-health allies can also survive, and receive the healing when the zone ends.

RekSai.phase: Early on, watch out for Rek’Sai’s ganks, avoid giving up kills, and stall for time. Later, focus on engaging to knock up multiple enemies rather than dealing damage with Wukong.
RekSai.build: Build armor first to prepare for Rek'Sai's main damage. Resistance does not reduce the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, so consider health as well, while keeping in mind that Rek'Sai R Void Rush deals damage based on your maximum health. Since basic attacks and attack speed are the core of her damage, reducing her attack speed is also effective.
RekSai.combo: When engaging, buffer Wukong Q Crushing Blow while dashing in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike so the empowered basic attack lands as you arrive. While Rek'Sai's knock-up and mobility are down, knock her up with Wukong R Cyclone, then immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics the ultimate too. Do not waste Wukong Q Crushing Blow while Rek'Sai leaps with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and cannot be targeted.
RekSai.escape: Avoid the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, and engage after Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel and Rek'Sai R Void Rush are down. If only one mobility ability is down, she can still escape with the other, so look especially for an opening before Rek'Sai R Void Rush comes back. Close the distance with Wukong E Nimbus Strike in that opening and use Wukong R Cyclone.
RekSai.fight: Avoid giving Rek'Sai kills through ganks early, and look for fights after gaining Wukong R Cyclone. Check Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow's knock-up, Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, and Rek'Sai R Void Rush's mobility before engaging. Once close, keep attacking to make use of the attack speed from Wukong E Nimbus Strike and reduce her armor with Wukong Q Crushing Blow.
RekSai.laning: Avoid pushing your lane too hard early, and do not walk alone through areas without vision. If you see a tunnel entrance made by Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel near a lane or in your jungle, step on it to destroy it. When clearing jungle camps, route between them to keep Wukong P Stone Skin stacks active, and save Wukong R Cyclone for fights.
RekSai.teamfight: Wait for the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow to be down and for two or more enemies to group together before looking for an engage. Close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike in sync with your team's crowd control, then move toward the grouped enemies while spinning with Wukong R Cyclone. Follow with Wukong W Warrior Trickster to add the clone's Wukong R Cyclone, and reposition while invisible to avoid counterattacks.
RekSai.watch: Watch for the knock-up when Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow erupts from underground. If you spot Burrow, avoid narrow paths and move into open space; create distance with Wukong W Warrior Trickster as Rek'Sai erupts. Immediately after taking damage from Rek'Sai, also watch for Rek'Sai R Void Rush and stay close to your allies.

Brand.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Brand deals mostly magic damage, and Wukong has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Brand.combo: Press Wukong Q Crushing Blow while dashing with Wukong E Nimbus Strike so you land the empowered basic attack as soon as you arrive. After dodging Brand Q Sear's stun, knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone and immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics the ultimate too.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility, so close the gap when Brand W Pillar of Flame is down. If you are ablaze, dodge Brand Q Sear's stun or wait until that ability is down before engaging with Wukong E Nimbus Strike. Use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to fake your direction while invisible or dodge a counterattack.
Brand.fight: After Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, there is an opportunity to engage if the distance remains within range. After also dodging Brand Q Sear's stun or confirming that the ability is down, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and follow up with an empowered basic attack and more basic attacks. Save Wukong W Warrior Trickster to dodge Brand's counterattack instead of using it right after engaging.
Brand.laning: Do not last-hit beside a burning minion. If the wave is clustered, step to the side before moving in. Look for an opening right after Brand uses Brand W Pillar of Flame to poke. In the jungle, keep clearing camps in sequence to maintain Wukong P Stone Skin stacks, and save Wukong R Cyclone for fights.
Brand.phase: Early on, Wukong is especially vulnerable to magic damage, so build magic resistance first and look for an advantage with early ganks. In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Brand.teamfight: Before engaging, spread out so Brand E Conflagration and Brand R Pyroclasm do not spread between allies. Once Brand Q Sear is down and two or more enemies are grouped, follow up on allied crowd control with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and use Wukong R Cyclone. Then use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics the ultimate while you avoid the counterattack in stealth.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks and explodes when you are hit by abilities in quick succession, so dodge from the first ability. If you are ablaze, move out of the line of Brand Q Sear's projectile or hide behind a minion. When you see Brand R Pyroclasm, spread out from allies to avoid its bouncing damage.

Briar.build: Build armor first against Briar's main damage from Briar P Crimson Curse, Q Head Rush, and W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Armor will not block the magic damage from Briar E Chilling Scream and R Certain Death. If the duel goes on for a long time, consider anti-heal after building resistances.
Briar.combo: Turn on Wukong Q Crushing Blow while closing in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike so you land the empowered basic attack as soon as you arrive. Follow up with basic attacks, then interrupt Briar E Chilling Scream when she starts charging it by using Wukong R Cyclone. If you use Wukong W Warrior Trickster right after R, the clone mimics the ultimate and you become invisible, letting you avoid the counterattack.
Briar.escape: Do not engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is down; also check Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and R Certain Death. In particular, while Briar R is down, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike when her mobility and main crowd control are unavailable, then use R Cyclone. Do not use Wukong W Warrior Trickster right after engaging; save it to dodge Briar's counterattack.
Briar.fight: Do not use Wukong E Nimbus Strike first while Briar still has her mobility ability available. When you have an opening to engage, press Q Crushing Blow while dashing with E so you land the empowered basic attack as soon as you arrive, then follow up with basic attacks to take advantage of the attack speed increase. Respond to Briar E Chilling Scream's charge with Wukong R Cyclone.
Briar.laning: Do not stay in the middle of lane for long when you lack vision. Push the lane and establish vision to turn Briar's reckless engage into a chance to counterattack. If you encounter Briar in the jungle, you can lower her health and delay her next route. Keep clearing jungle camps in sequence to maintain Wukong P Stone Skin stacks, and save Wukong R Cyclone for fights.
Briar.phase: Briar often gets involved in kills early, so establish vision and counterattack reckless engages. In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with R rather than dealing damage.
Briar.teamfight: While Briar is in W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, she targets the nearest enemy, so stand on the frontline and protect your backline damage dealers. Interrupt Briar E Chilling Scream when she charges it with the knock-up from Wukong R Cyclone. When two or more enemies are grouped and you can time it with allied crowd control, close in with E Nimbus Strike and spin R.
Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush stuns and reduces armor, so watch out for the follow-up attacks right after it hits. When Briar E Chilling Scream starts charging, interrupt it with the knock-up from Wukong R Cyclone, and avoid positions with a wall behind you. Briar R Certain Death's bloodstone targets the first champion it hits, so stand in front of your allied backline damage dealers.

Diana.build: Diana's main damage is magic, and Wukong has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Early on, withstand her damage with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Diana.combo: Once Diana E Lunar Rush is down and the shield from Diana W Pale Cascade is gone, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike. If you use Wukong W Warrior Trickster right after knocking her up with Wukong R Cyclone, the clone mimics the ultimate and you become invisible, letting you avoid the counterattack.
Diana.escape: Right after Diana E Lunar Rush is down is your window to close the gap. If Diana R Moonfall is also down, there is less risk of your Wukong R Cyclone being interrupted while spinning. Conversely, if you are hit by Diana Q Crescent Strike and marked, stop the engage and create distance.
Diana.fight: Start trading after the orbs from Diana W Pale Cascade disappear and its shield is gone. If Diana E Lunar Rush is down, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and use the attack speed increase to keep landing basic attacks. If Diana dashes in with E Lunar Rush without a mark, use Wukong R Cyclone to knock her up and look for a chance to catch her.
Diana.laning: Save Wukong Q Crushing Blow for fights against champions.
Diana.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging to knock up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Diana.teamfight: Spread out so multiple allies are not pulled by Diana R Moonfall, and establish vision on the flanking route. Once Diana R Moonfall is down and two or more enemies are grouped, follow up on allied crowd control with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and use Wukong R Cyclone. Use Wukong W Warrior Trickster right away to add the clone's ultimate, then avoid the counterattack while invisible.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies, so dodge to the side instead of only moving back. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush can dash in again, so create distance. Do not fight while the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are still up.

Elise.build: Elise's main damage is magic, so withstand it first with a Null-Magic Mantle and build magic resistance. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots to deal with the stun from Elise E Cocoon.
Elise.combo: Once Elise E Cocoon / Rappel and Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite are down, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike while pressing Wukong Q Crushing Blow in advance to land the empowered basic attack immediately. Then knock her up with Wukong R Cyclone and use Wukong W Warrior Trickster right away so the clone also spins its ultimate while you avoid the counterattack.
Elise.escape: Right after Elise uses Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite is a window to close the gap with Wukong E Nimbus Strike or Wukong W Warrior Trickster. Once both Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are down, catch her with Wukong R Cyclone and turn the fight around.
Elise.fight: Close the gap after Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite and Elise E Cocoon / Rappel are down. As you engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike, activate Wukong Q Crushing Blow in advance so you land the empowered basic attack as soon as you arrive, then use your increased attack speed to keep landing basic attacks.
Elise.laning: Establish plenty of vision early and do not push the lane recklessly when Elise is missing. Stand behind minions in lane to dodge Elise E Cocoon, and maintain Wukong P Stone Skin stacks along your jungle route as you prepare for fights.
Elise.phase: Early on, watch out for Elise looking to gain an advantage with ganks. Avoid giving up kills while looking for early gank opportunities yourself. In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Elise.teamfight: When Elise E Cocoon / Rappel are down and two or more enemies are grouped, follow up on allied crowd control with Wukong E Nimbus Strike. Move toward the grouped enemies while spinning Wukong R Cyclone, then use Wukong W Warrior Trickster right away to leave the clone's ultimate active while dodging the counterattack.
Elise.watch: When health is full, watch out for Elise Q Neurotoxin. After health has decreased, watch for a finishing engage when Elise transforms into a spider, and save Wukong W Warrior Trickster.

Gragas.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Gragas mainly deals magic damage, and Wukong has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Gragas has relatively high armor, so consider armor penetration when dealing physical damage.
Gragas.combo: Once Gragas E Body Slam is down, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and press Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash so you land the empowered basic attack as soon as you arrive. Then use Wukong R Cyclone and immediately follow up with Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone also spins its ultimate.
Gragas.escape: Right after you force Gragas to use E Body Slam is a chance to engage. Close the gap then with Wukong W Warrior Trickster or Wukong E Nimbus Strike, and follow up by knocking the enemy up with Wukong R Cyclone if it is ready. If Gragas R Explosive Cask is still available, watch where it could knock you as you go in.
Gragas.fight: If Gragas starts drinking with W Drunken Rage, save your heavy damage until its damage reduction ends. When fighting, use Wukong Q Crushing Blow to reduce Gragas's armor, then close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and use the attack speed increase to keep landing basic attacks.
Gragas.laning: Keep clearing jungle camps in sequence to maintain Wukong P Stone Skin stacks, and look for an advantage with early ganks. Do not stay in range of Gragas Q Barrel Roll, and do not use Wukong E Nimbus Strike first while Gragas E Body Slam is available. Save Wukong R Cyclone for champion fights rather than camps.
Gragas.phase: Early on, watch out for Gragas's burst damage and ability to disrupt your formation while looking to gain an advantage with Wukong's early ganks. Gragas's sustained damage falls off in the late game, so focus on engaging to knock up multiple enemies rather than dealing damage.
Gragas.teamfight: Watch out for Gragas E Body Slam and Gragas R Explosive Cask, and do not let your backline stand alone and exposed in narrow passages or brush without vision. When two or more enemies are grouped and Gragas's main crowd control is down, coordinate the engage order with allies and close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike to spin Wukong R Cyclone. Use Wukong W Warrior Trickster right away; while the clone mimics the ultimate, you become invisible and can avoid the counterattack.
Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, leave its area before it explodes. If you are near the barrel and also get hit by Gragas E Body Slam, you are likely to be hit by both abilities. When Gragas R Explosive Cask is ready, do not stand with your back to an enemy turret or the enemy team.

Graves.build: Get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first. Graves' main damage is physical, but armor cannot block the magic damage from Graves W Smoke Screen.
Graves.combo: When Graves' mobility is down, press Wukong Q Crushing Blow during Wukong E Nimbus Strike's dash so the empowered basic attack lands as soon as you arrive. Then knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone and immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone spins the ultimate too.
Graves.escape: If only Graves E Quickdraw is down, he can still escape with Graves R Collateral Damage, so wait to engage. In particular, look for an opening when both mobility abilities are down, before Graves R Collateral Damage comes back up; if you are caught in Smoke Screen, leave its area first.
Graves.fight: Trade back while Graves reloads after firing two shots. When Graves E Quickdraw and Graves R Collateral Damage are both down, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and follow up with basic attacks.
Graves.laning: Push or pressure the lane early to limit Graves' chances to stack Graves E Quickdraw. While jungling, chain camps so Wukong P Stone Skin stacks do not expire, and look for an early gank to gain an advantage.
Graves.phase: Pressure Graves early to keep him from stacking and look for an early gank. Graves gets stronger as the game goes on, so in the late game focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone.
Graves.teamfight: When at least two enemies are grouped and you can coordinate the engage order with your allies' crowd control, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and spin Wukong R Cyclone. Move toward the grouped enemies while spinning, then immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to leave the clone's ultimate active and avoid retaliation.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits terrain, so do not fight with your back to a wall or in narrow jungle passages. If you are caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, leave its area by the shortest route, then re-engage. Graves P New Destiny's basic attack is blocked by the first unit it hits, so keep minions or an ally between you and Graves.

Hecarim.build: Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge deal most of their damage as physical damage, so build armor first. Hecarim W Spirit of Dread and Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows deal magic damage, which armor cannot block.
Hecarim.combo: After Hecarim E Devastating Charge and Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows are down, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike, pressing Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash so the empowered basic attack lands as soon as you arrive. Then knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone and immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone also uses R Cyclone while you avoid retaliation.
Hecarim.escape: If only Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down, he can escape with Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows, so do not rush your engage. When both mobility abilities are down, especially before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows comes back up, close the distance with Wukong W Warrior Trickster and Wukong E Nimbus Strike and land Wukong R Cyclone.
Hecarim.fight: When re-engaging, use the attack speed increase from Wukong E Nimbus Strike to keep up your basic attacks, and reduce Hecarim's armor with Wukong Q Crushing Blow. If you hit a jungle monster before the fight to stack Wukong P Stone Skin, you can start the fight more durable.
Hecarim.laning: Look for an early gank to gain an advantage, but keep chaining camps to maintain Wukong P Stone Skin stacks. Save Wukong R Cyclone for the next fight instead of using it on camps.
Hecarim.phase: In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Hecarim.teamfight: Keep your formation spread out so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows does not fear several allies at once. After Hecarim E Devastating Charge and Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows are down, if at least two enemies are grouped, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike in sync with your allies' crowd control and spin Wukong R Cyclone. Immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to add the clone's R Cyclone and avoid Hecarim's retaliation.
Hecarim.watch: The farther Hecarim runs with Hecarim E Devastating Charge, the more damage and knockback it deals, so break vision or move toward your allies when Hecarim turns and starts running. While Hecarim W Spirit of Dread is active, staying nearby and fighting for a long time helps him heal, so back out of range and then re-engage. Spread out from allies so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows does not fear several of you at once.

Ivern.build: Get a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots early. Ivern deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance before armor; however, tenacity is also important when allies can follow up on the root from Ivern Q Rootcaller and the knockup from Ivern R Daisy!.
Ivern.combo: After Ivern Q Rootcaller is down, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and press Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash. Land the empowered basic attack as soon as you arrive, then move toward the grouped enemies and use Wukong R Cyclone. Follow with Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics the ultimate while Wukong becomes invisible and avoids retaliation.
Ivern.escape: The moment after you bait Ivern Q Rootcaller is your window to engage. Close the distance with Wukong W Warrior Trickster and Wukong E Nimbus Strike, then land Wukong R Cyclone. Wait to engage with Wukong R Cyclone if the crowd control from Ivern Q Rootcaller or Ivern R Daisy! is still available.
Ivern.fight: Close the distance after Ivern Q Rootcaller is down and Ivern E Triggerseed has burst. If you activate Wukong Q Crushing Blow during Wukong E Nimbus Strike, you can start the trade with an empowered basic attack as soon as you arrive. Target an ally Ivern has shielded before chasing Ivern too far.
Ivern.laning: Ward Ivern's jungle early to track his route back to harvest the camps where he planted seeds. Do not casually walk beside newly created Ivern W Brushmaker; clear vision there to remove the ambush spot. Save Wukong R Cyclone for the next fight instead of using it on camps.
Ivern.phase: In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Ivern.teamfight: Wait for the crowd control from Ivern Q Rootcaller and Ivern R Daisy! to be down and for at least two enemies to group up. Coordinate the engage order with your allies' crowd control, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike, then move toward the grouped enemies as you spin Wukong R Cyclone. Use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to leave the clone behind and circle around into the backline; target an ally Ivern has shielded before targeting Ivern.
Ivern.watch: If you are rooted by Ivern Q Rootcaller, Ivern's allies can rush in, so stand behind minions or terrain before he throws it. If you immediately approach a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed, you will also be slowed when the shield bursts, so engage after it explodes. If Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, reposition to avoid its repeated attacks and knockups.

JarvanIV.build: If you can reduce attack speed, it will help reduce the damage you take from basic attacks.
JarvanIV.combo: Keep up your basic attacks, then knock the enemy up with Wukong R Cyclone and immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster; the clone will mimic the ultimate while Wukong becomes invisible and avoids retaliation.
JarvanIV.fight: When closing in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike, press Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash so the empowered basic attack lands as soon as you arrive, then use the increased attack speed to keep up your basic attacks. Do not spend Wukong W Warrior Trickster right after engaging; use it to dodge retaliation or fake your direction.
JarvanIV.laning: While jungling, keep chaining camps to maintain Wukong P Stone Skin stacks, and you can also hit a nearby jungle monster before a fight to build stacks. Save Wukong R Cyclone for fights instead of farming.
JarvanIV.teamfight: During your ultimate, move toward the grouped enemies, then use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to leave the clone's ultimate active and avoid retaliation.

Jax.build: Jax's main damage comes from basic attacks and attack speed, so prioritize considering items that reduce attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike ends and Jax Q Leap Strike is down, dash in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike while activating Wukong Q Crushing Blow so the empowered basic attack lands as soon as you arrive. Then knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone and immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics the ultimate.
Jax.escape: The moment after both Jax Q Leap Strike and Jax E Counter Strike are down is Wukong's window to engage. While Jax E Counter Strike is active, save a movement tool such as Wukong W Warrior Trickster and leave the stun radius.
Jax.fight: Look for a trade after Jax E Counter Strike is down. Once you confirm Jax Q Leap Strike has also been used, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and follow up with basic attacks.
Jax.phase: In the late game, Wukong should focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax jumps in with Jax E Counter Strike active, do not bunch up around him; wait for the area stun to end. Then, when at least two enemies are grouped, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and use Wukong R Cyclone, coordinating the engage order with your allies' crowd control.
Jax.watch: Do not engage first with Wukong E Nimbus Strike while Jax Q Leap Strike is available.

Karthus.build: Get a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots early. Karthus deals magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance over armor. However, avoiding Karthus W Wall of Pain and quickly leaving the range of Karthus E Defile comes before building more resistance.
Karthus.combo: Press Wukong Q Crushing Blow during Wukong E Nimbus Strike's dash so the empowered basic attack lands as soon as you arrive. Then knock Karthus up with Wukong R Cyclone and immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics the ultimate. After killing him, do not stay near his corpse until Karthus P Death Defied ends.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no ability to create distance, so when you find an angle within range of Wukong E Nimbus Strike, that is your chance to engage. If Karthus W Wall of Pain is placed, do not enter by crossing the wall; take a path around it. Immediately after killing Karthus, use the movement and stealth from Wukong W Warrior Trickster to get away from his corpse.
Karthus.fight: Karthus has no ability to create distance on his own, so when you see an angle to get close, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and follow up with basic attacks. Karthus has relatively low armor, so Wukong's physical damage is effective, and Wukong Q Crushing Blow can reduce his armor further. Fight while dodging the warning areas from Karthus Q Lay Waste, and move away from his corpse immediately after killing him.
Karthus.laning: Chain your route between camps so Wukong P Stone Skin stacks do not expire, and save Wukong Q Crushing Blow for champion fights. Wukong R Cyclone is needed for the next fight, so do not use it to farm camps.
Karthus.phase: Early on, look for an advantage with ganks or invades before Karthus scales quickly. In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Karthus.teamfight: Look for a chance to clear the enemy frontline together with your allies before Karthus can get into Karthus E Defile range. If at least two enemies are grouped, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike in sync with your allies' crowd control, then continue moving in as you spin Wukong R Cyclone. Even if you kill Karthus first, he can still deal damage during Karthus P Death Defied, so reposition immediately.
Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals more damage when it hits you alone, so walk out of the way when you see the blast warning and, if possible, stand on top of minions or allies. Passing through Karthus W Wall of Pain slows you and reduces your magic resistance, so move around the wall and do not stay in range of Karthus E Defile for long. Even after you kill Karthus, he can cast abilities near his corpse with Karthus P Death Defied, so move away immediately and keep enough health after the fight to survive Karthus R Requiem.

Kayn.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, Kayn W Blade's Reach, and Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Kayn Q Reaping Slash deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone. If Kayn has transformed into the Darkin and you expect a long duel, consider grievous wounds after building resistances.
Kayn.combo: When Kayn W Blade's Reach is down and Kayn R Umbral Trespass is unavailable, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike, pressing Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash. Land the empowered basic attack as soon as you arrive, then knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone. Follow with Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics the ultimate while Wukong becomes invisible and avoids retaliation.
Kayn.escape: Do not engage just because Kayn Q Reaping Slash is down. Your opportunity to engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and land Wukong R Cyclone is when Kayn R Umbral Trespass is not back up yet and Kayn W Blade's Reach is also down. Do not immediately spend Wukong W Warrior Trickster after engaging; use it to dodge Kayn's retaliation or escape.
Kayn.fight: Early on, pressure Kayn's jungle routes while he is weak before transforming, but do not engage first with Wukong E Nimbus Strike while both Kayn Q Reaping Slash and Kayn R Umbral Trespass are available. When you find an opportunity to get close, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike, pressing Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash so the empowered basic attack lands as soon as you arrive, then use the increased attack speed to keep up your basic attacks. If the fight goes long, make use of the armor and healing stacks from Wukong P Stone Skin.
Kayn.laning: Pressure Kayn's jungle before he transforms and delay his transformation with objective fights. Chain jungle camps to maintain Wukong P Stone Skin stacks, and you can hit a nearby jungle monster just before a fight to build stacks. Save Wukong R Cyclone for fights against Kayn or objective fights instead of using it to farm camps.
Kayn.phase: Early on, pressure Kayn while he is weak before transforming to delay his transformation, but keep in mind that Wukong's early clear speed and damage are average, so look for an early gank to gain an advantage. In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Kayn.teamfight: After Kayn W Blade's Reach is down, if at least two enemies are grouped, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and use Wukong R Cyclone, coordinating the engage order with your allies' crowd control. Move toward the grouped enemies while spinning, then use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to make use of stealth and the clone's ultimate. If Kayn R Umbral Trespass is on an ally, be ready to interrupt Kayn with the knockup from Wukong R Cyclone when he emerges near the target.
Kayn.watch: Kayn W Blade's Reach comes in a straight line and knocks you up, so dodge sideways before Kayn can hit you with it from a distance. Kayn can use Kayn R Umbral Trespass only on a target he has already damaged. If you see the warning for Kayn E Shadow Step at the edge of a wall, stop fighting and retreat toward a turret.

LeeSin.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Lee Sin E Tempest / Cripple. If his basic attacks are a problem, reducing his attack speed can also help.
LeeSin.combo: When Lee Sin's mobility spell is down, press Wukong Q Crushing Blow while dashing in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike so your empowered attack lands as soon as you arrive. Then knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone and immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics your ultimate. If Wukong R Cyclone is available again, use the second cast to finish him or hinder his escape.
LeeSin.escape: Don't rush in when only Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike is down; Lee Sin can still escape with Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will.
LeeSin.fight: If you encounter Lee Sin in the jungle early, retreat instead of accepting a duel. When fighting, wait until Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will are down, then close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and keep attacking. Focus your damage right after Lee Sin uses Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will to engage.
LeeSin.laning: Keep clearing jungle camps so Wukong P Stone Skin stacks don't expire, and hit a monster just before a fight to build stacks. Save Wukong R Cyclone for fights instead of using it on camps.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so buy time with objectives and lane advantages instead of fighting him head-on. Lee Sin falls off later, and Wukong should focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
LeeSin.teamfight: Before a teamfight, spread out so an ally kicked by Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage doesn't knock you up too, and don't stand directly behind a high-health ally. After Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage is down, when two or more enemies group together, coordinate with your team's crowd control, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike, and spin with Wukong R Cyclone. While spinning, use the movement speed bonus to move toward the grouped enemies.
LeeSin.watch: If the first hit drops your health below half, retreat toward an allied turret or your team while the second hit is still available. Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will can also be used with a ward to engage over a wall, so keep your distance from walls where you lack vision.

MasterYi.build: Resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style, so build health too. Use ways to reduce attack speed to slow his basic attacks and delay his next use of Master Yi Q Alpha Strike.
MasterYi.combo: After Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and press Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash so your empowered attack lands as soon as you arrive. Then knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone and immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics your ultimate.
MasterYi.escape: Immediately after making Master Yi use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, you have a chance to close the gap with Wukong W Warrior Trickster or Wukong E Nimbus Strike. After Master Yi lands, knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone to prevent his escape.
MasterYi.fight: After making Master Yi use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike when he lands and keep attacking. If Master Yi holds out with Master Yi W Meditate, interrupt it with the airborne from Wukong R Cyclone. Don't rush to use Wukong W Warrior Trickster immediately after engaging; use it to dodge a counterattack or combo with your ultimate.
MasterYi.laning: Master Yi is weak in the jungle early, so look for chances to fight him when you encounter him and disrupt his scaling with early objectives. Keep clearing camps to maintain Wukong P Stone Skin stacks, and save Wukong R Cyclone for fights instead of using it to clear.
MasterYi.phase: Master Yi is weak in the jungle early, so don't delay taking opportunities to fight or contest objectives. Master Yi gets stronger as the game goes on, so in the late game Wukong should focus on knocking up multiple enemies with his ultimate instead of dealing damage.
MasterYi.teamfight: Respond together so Master Yi can't pick off an ally alone and get a takedown. When two or more enemies group together, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike, spin with your ultimate, and coordinate with your allies' crowd control.
MasterYi.watch: Master Yi can't be targeted while using Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so don't use your finishing blow before he lands. Master Yi E Wuju Style adds true damage to his basic attacks, and slows don't work while Master Yi R Highlander is active, so avoid staying close and taking hits for long.

Nocturne.build: Build armor first against Nocturne's main damage from Nocturne P Umbra Blades, Nocturne Q Duskbringer, and Nocturne R Paranoia. Armor won't stop the magic damage from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Nocturne.combo: During the dash with Wukong E Nimbus Strike, activate Wukong Q Crushing Blow beforehand to land an empowered basic attack as you arrive. Use Wukong R Cyclone after Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is down and you have dodged Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. If you follow Wukong R Cyclone immediately with Wukong W Warrior Trickster, the clone mimics the ultimate while Wukong turns invisible and avoids retaliation.
Nocturne.escape: If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is also down, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and use Wukong R Cyclone. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is still available, save Wukong W Warrior Trickster to break the tether.
Nocturne.fight: Open a fight with Wukong E Nimbus Strike while Nocturne R Paranoia is down. Save Wukong W Warrior Trickster to deal with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Nocturne.laning: Chain jungle camps to keep Wukong P Stone Skin stacks active, and attack a nearby jungle monster just before a fight to build stacks. Keep vision around the river and jungle entrances against Nocturne R Paranoia, and decide in advance where to retreat. Save Wukong R Cyclone for fights instead of using it on camps.
Nocturne.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging to knock up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens the screen, immediately move toward your allies so you aren't isolated. After Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness and Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror are down, use Wukong E Nimbus Strike to close in and spin Wukong R Cyclone when two or more enemies group together. Coordinate your entry with your allies' crowd control, and use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to leave a clone and avoid retaliation.
Nocturne.watch: Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror triggers fear if the tether remains connected, so use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to create distance as soon as it connects. Don't use Wukong R Cyclone right away while Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is available. If Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, don't run straight along its trail; turn toward your allies or turret.

Nunu.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nunu & Willump's damage is mostly magic, and Wukong has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume makes it hard to finish him, get Grievous Wounds with Executioner's Calling.
Nunu.combo: When engaging, press Wukong Q Crushing Blow while dashing in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike so your empowered attack lands as soon as you arrive. If Nunu & Willump's crowd control is down, knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone and immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics your ultimate. Wukong can move aside while invisible to avoid a counterattack.
Nunu.escape: An opening to engage comes when Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage are down and Wukong R Cyclone is ready. Nunu & Willump has no skill to create distance, so close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and use Wukong R Cyclone. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to get out before the root lands.
Nunu.fight: After Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage are down, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike. Press Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash so your empowered attack lands as soon as you arrive, then use follow-up attacks to make use of Wukong E Nimbus Strike's attack speed bonus. Keep in mind that Nunu & Willump can restore health with Nunu & Willump Q Consume when trading.
Nunu.laning: Stay alert even after one gank, since Nunu & Willump can come back through the river crab. If a fight is coming up in the jungle, hit a nearby monster to build Wukong P Stone Skin stacks.
Nunu.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging to knock up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone instead of dealing damage.
Nunu.teamfight: After Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage are down, if two or more enemies group together, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and spin with Wukong R Cyclone. If Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero begins, you can interrupt the channel with the airborne from Wukong R Cyclone. Immediately after Wukong R Cyclone, use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics your ultimate while you avoid a counterattack.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from far away and knocks you up, so don't just run backward; sidestep toward the snowball and retreat to where Nunu & Willump was just standing. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to get out before the delayed root. Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero slows more strongly inside its area, so interrupt the channel with Wukong R Cyclone or leave the area.

Rammus.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Rammus's main damage is magic, and Wukong has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Rammus.combo: After Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends and Rammus's crowd control is down, use Wukong E Nimbus Strike to engage and buffer Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash so the empowered basic attack lands as you arrive. If enemies are grouped together, knock them up with Wukong R Cyclone, then immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone keeps spinning with the ultimate.
Rammus.escape: Once Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are down, close the distance with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and use Wukong R Cyclone.
Rammus.fight: When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, avoid hitting Rammus to prevent reflected damage triggered by basic attacks; attack another target instead. Once it ends, use Wukong Q Crushing Blow to reduce his armor and focus your damage. Save Wukong W Warrior Trickster for dodging Rammus's counterattack instead of using it right after engaging.
Rammus.laning: Keep minions in the path of Rammus Q Powerball to block his approach. When clearing jungle camps, chain them together so Wukong P Stone Skin stacks do not expire, and save Wukong R Cyclone for the next fight.
Rammus.phase: In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Rammus.teamfight: Wait until Rammus Q Powerball, Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and Rammus R Soaring Slam are down, then engage in sync with your team's crowd control. If two or more enemies are grouped together, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and spin with Wukong R Cyclone, then immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone continues the ultimate. If Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, attack another target instead of Rammus.
Rammus.watch: Rammus Q Powerball speeds up the longer it rolls, so keep minions between you and Rammus to block his approach. If you are affected by Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, you cannot move or use abilities, so wait outside its range. Rammus R Soaring Slam covers a wider area when cast after Rammus Q Powerball closes the distance quickly, so move well clear and avoid the landing point.

Rengar.build: Build armor first to prepare for Rengar's main damage. Armor does not block the magic damage from Rengar W Battle Roar, and the armor you build is less effective while Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt reduces your armor.
Rengar.combo: After dodging Rengar E Bola Strike and confirming Rengar W Battle Roar is down, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike. Then use Wukong R Cyclone and immediately follow with Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics the ultimate too.
Rengar.escape: After Rengar E Bola Strike is down, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike. Once Rengar has leapt and used Rengar W Battle Roar, you have an opportunity to catch him with Wukong R Cyclone.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar's resource bar is empty. Confirm Rengar W Battle Roar is down, then use Wukong R Cyclone and deal your damage. If you dodge Rengar E Bola Strike, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and keep attacking to make use of the attack speed.
Rengar.laning: When Rengar is out of sight, do not pass by brush; use a Control Ward to get vision of it. If you can hit a jungle monster just before a fight, build Wukong P Stone Skin stacks to increase your armor and healing. Save Wukong Q Crushing Blow and Wukong R Cyclone for the next champion fight.
Rengar.phase: Wukong's clear speed and damage per minute are average early, so create an advantage with early ganks. In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Rengar.teamfight: Set up near your team's frontline and within vision to counter Rengar's engage. Once Rengar W Battle Roar is down and two or more enemies are grouped together, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike in sync with your team's crowd control and knock them up with Wukong R Cyclone. Leave a clone with Wukong W Warrior Trickster, then circle around to reach the backline.
Rengar.watch: When Rengar's resource bar is full, Rengar E Bola Strike roots you, and Rengar W Battle Roar removes crowd control, so avoid trading then. When Rengar is out of sight, avoid paths next to brush and secure vision. Do not roam alone while injured, in case of Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt.

Sejuani.build: Sejuani's main damage is magic, and Wukong has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Sejuani.combo: Once Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and buffer Wukong Q Crushing Blow. After landing the empowered basic attack, confirm Sejuani's main crowd control is down, then knock her up with Wukong R Cyclone. Using Wukong W Warrior Trickster afterward makes the clone mimic Wukong R Cyclone while Wukong turns invisible and can avoid counterattacks.
Sejuani.escape: Right after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down is an opportunity to close the distance with Wukong W Warrior Trickster and Wukong E Nimbus Strike. Use Wukong R Cyclone after the crowd control from Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, Sejuani E Permafrost, and Sejuani R Glacial Prison is down.
Sejuani.fight: Bait out Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, then engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike. Buffer Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash so the empowered basic attack lands as you arrive, then keep attacking to make use of the attack speed from Wukong E Nimbus Strike. If you are hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath, get out before the second to reduce the damage you take in the trade.
Sejuani.laning: Look for early gains through ganks, and chain jungle camps together to maintain Wukong P Stone Skin stacks. You can build stacks by hitting a nearby jungle monster just before a fight. Save Wukong R Cyclone for fights and objective contests instead of using it on camps.
Sejuani.phase: Sejuani has low kill and damage stats early, so look for opportunities to gain an advantage through ganks and jungle control. In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Sejuani.teamfight: When Sejuani's main crowd control is down and two or more enemies are grouped together, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike in sync with your team's crowd control. Move into the grouped enemies while spinning with Wukong R Cyclone, then follow with Wukong W Warrior Trickster to add the clone's Wukong R Cyclone. If Wukong R Cyclone is available again, use it to finish enemies or deter their escape.
Sejuani.watch: Dodge Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison by watching their windups and moving sideways. If you are hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath, get out of range before the second. If hits from Sejuani or her melee allies build Sejuani E Permafrost stacks on you, immediately create distance.

Shaco.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against the damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate.
Shaco.combo: Once Shaco Q Deceive is down, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and buffer Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash. Land the empowered basic attack as you arrive, and if the crowd control from Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate is down, knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone. Following with Wukong W Warrior Trickster makes the remaining clone mimic the ultimate while Wukong turns invisible to avoid counterattacks.
Shaco.escape: Right after baiting out Shaco Q Deceive is an opening to close the distance with Wukong W Warrior Trickster and Wukong E Nimbus Strike. Engage with Wukong R Cyclone after the crowd control from Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate is down.
Shaco.fight: Do not use Wukong E Nimbus Strike first while Shaco Q Deceive is available. When Shaco appears from Shaco Q Deceive, focus your damage on him immediately with your allies, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike, and keep attacking to make use of the attack speed. Save Wukong W Warrior Trickster after engaging to dodge the enemy's counterattack or mislead them about your direction.
Shaco.laning: Keep vision at your jungle entrances early to prepare for Shaco's ganks and invades. Chain jungle camps together to maintain Wukong P Stone Skin stacks, and you can also hit a nearby jungle monster to build stacks just before a fight. Save Wukong R Cyclone for fights instead of clearing camps, and start objective fights only when the ultimate is ready.
Shaco.phase: Shaco looks for an advantage through ganks and invades early, so avoid giving him kills, maintain vision, and take objectives. In the late game, Shaco is weaker in solo fights, and Wukong should focus on engaging to knock up multiple enemies rather than dealing damage.
Shaco.teamfight: When Shaco appears from Shaco Q Deceive, focus your damage on Shaco himself with your allies. Distinguish the Shaco R Hallucinate clone by its health bar response; when it dies, move away to avoid the explosion and fear. When two or more enemies are grouped together and Shaco's crowd control is down, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike in sync with your team, then use Wukong R Cyclone.
Shaco.watch: Watch for the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in brush without vision and around objectives. Clear boxes in advance with a Control Ward or Oracle Lens; when a Shaco R Hallucinate clone dies, step away from the explosion and the boxes. If Shaco is nearby, keep your back to a wall or face your allies so he cannot get behind you.

Shyvana.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, Shyvana E Molten Burst, and Shyvana R Dragon's Descent.
Shyvana.combo: Once Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is down, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and buffer Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash so the empowered basic attack lands as soon as you arrive. Then knock her up with Wukong R Cyclone and immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone spins with the ultimate too.
Shyvana.escape: Do not engage first with Wukong E Nimbus Strike while Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is available. If Shyvana engages with her ultimate, wait while she is unstoppable, then use Wukong R Cyclone after she lands. Shyvana's empty Fury bar is also an opportunity to pressure her.
Shyvana.fight: Pressure Shyvana early, while she has few growth stacks. If Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is available, do not use Wukong E Nimbus Strike first; engage and fight after Shyvana lands or uses her ultimate. Once close, reduce her armor with Wukong Q Crushing Blow and keep attacking.
Shyvana.laning: Create an advantage early through ganks and jungle invades, and hinder Shyvana as she builds Shyvana P Scalemail stacks from camps and objectives. Chain jungle camps together so Wukong P Stone Skin stacks do not expire, and save Wukong R Cyclone for fights instead of clearing camps. Start an objective when Shyvana's Fury bar is empty and Wukong R Cyclone is ready.
Shyvana.phase: Wukong should pressure Shyvana early, while she has few growth stacks, with ganks and invades. In the late game, once Shyvana P Scalemail stacks have built up, it becomes harder to catch her the same way, so focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out so multiple allies are not hit together by the path of Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, or Shyvana E Molten Burst. If Shyvana engages with her ultimate, knock her up with Wukong R Cyclone after she lands. When two or more enemies are grouped together, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike in sync with your team's crowd control, spin with the ultimate, then immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to avoid counterattacks.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana E Molten Burst slows and deals damage based on your maximum health, so create distance after being hit to avoid being followed by the empowered basic attack from Shyvana Q Emberstrike. Shyvana is unstoppable while flying with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, so do not try to interrupt her engage; knock her up with Wukong R Cyclone after she lands.

Skarner.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Skarner's main damage, and buy a Null-Magic Mantle early. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Skarner R Impale's suppression cannot be reduced with resistance, so decide in advance whether you need a cleansing item.
Skarner.combo: Once Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and buffer Wukong Q Crushing Blow. Land the empowered basic attack as soon as you arrive, knock Skarner up with Wukong R Cyclone, then use Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics the ultimate too. While invisible, Wukong can reposition to avoid Skarner's counterattack.
Skarner.escape: Right after baiting out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is an opportunity to close the distance with Wukong W Warrior Trickster or Wukong E Nimbus Strike. Use Wukong R Cyclone after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and Skarner R Impale are down. If you are stunned by a collision with a wall, retreat while accounting for Skarner's next dash.
