Skarner.fight: Bait out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact first, then close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike. Avoid extended trades where you keep taking empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval.
Skarner.laning: Chain jungle camps together to maintain Wukong P Stone Skin stacks, and look for gains through early ganks. You can build stacks by hitting a nearby jungle monster just before a fight. Save Wukong R Cyclone for fights with Skarner or objective contests instead of using it on camps.
Skarner.phase: Wukong's clear speed and damage are average early, so use early ganks and jungle control to delay Skarner's item timing. In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Skarner.teamfight: Once Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and Skarner R Impale are down and two or more enemies are grouped together, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike in sync with your team's crowd control and spin with Wukong R Cyclone. Move into the grouped enemies while spinning. Then use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to leave a clone that mimics the ultimate, and circle around to reposition.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact stuns on collision with a wall, so do not stand with your back to one. Skarner R Impale suppresses you and cannot be removed with movement abilities such as Wukong W Warrior Trickster, so keep your distance before Skarner gets close. Do not fight for long while caught, so you avoid taking repeated empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval.

Taliyah.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Taliyah's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and prioritize magic resistance afterward as well.
Taliyah.combo: After avoiding the minefield from Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and buffer Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash. Land the empowered basic attack as soon as you arrive, and use Wukong R Cyclone when you have an angle to knock her up. Following with Wukong W Warrior Trickster lets the clone mimic the ultimate while Wukong turns invisible to avoid counterattacks.
Taliyah.escape: Look for an engage after Taliyah W Seismic Shove and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth are down. If you have only drawn out one of Taliyah's escape tools, watch for the one she still has, and especially look for an opening before Taliyah R Weaver's Wall comes back off cooldown. Use Wukong W Warrior Trickster or Wukong E Nimbus Strike in that opening to close the distance and use Wukong R Cyclone.
Taliyah.fight: While Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is laid down, do not dash; walk in or go around the minefield to find an angle. When you can get close, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and keep attacking to make use of the attack speed for your empowered and follow-up basic attacks. Save Wukong W Warrior Trickster after engaging to dodge Taliyah's counterattack or mislead her about your direction.
Taliyah.laning: Chain jungle camps together to maintain Wukong P Stone Skin stacks, and look for gains through early ganks. If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, she may intervene in another lane, so back off in advance. Start objective fights when Wukong R Cyclone is ready; if it is down, take vision and retreat.
Taliyah.phase: Wukong's clear speed is average early, and he is vulnerable to Taliyah's magic damage, so build resistance and look for early gank opportunities. In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Taliyah.teamfight: Engage in sync with your team's crowd control after Taliyah's main crowd control, such as Taliyah W Seismic Shove and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, is down. If two or more enemies are grouped together, close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and spin with Wukong R Cyclone as you move. Follow with Wukong W Warrior Trickster to leave a clone that mimics the ultimate, then circle around while invisible to find an angle into the backline.
Taliyah.watch: Taliyah Q Threaded Volley cannot change direction while being cast, so sidestep instead of running straight at her. Do not dash across the field of rocks with Wukong E Nimbus Strike or Wukong W Warrior Trickster.

Udyr.build: Consider armor items first against Udyr's physical damage. Armor won't stop the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both damage types, so one type of resistance can't block all of it. His damage relies on basic attacks and attack speed, so consider ways to reduce his attack speed as well.
Udyr.combo: When Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down, use Wukong E Nimbus Strike to engage and activate Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash. Land an empowered basic attack as you arrive and keep attacking, then knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone after Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect ends. Follow with Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics Wukong R Cyclone while Wukong turns invisible and avoids retaliation.
Udyr.escape: Udyr E Blazing Stampede provides both mobility and a stun, so right after you bait it out, you have a window to close the distance with Wukong W Warrior Trickster or Wukong E Nimbus Strike. If you've already been stunned, retaliate or get away during the period when that stun cannot affect the same target again. Use Wukong R Cyclone after Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect ends to prevent him from escaping.
Udyr.fight: Use Wukong E Nimbus Strike to close in immediately after you bait out Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Continue attacking once Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield is gone, then knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone after Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect ends.
Udyr.laning: When Udyr is out of sight, ward key routes and jungle entrances, and don't push up in lane until you know his path. Look for gains with Wukong's early ganks and chain jungle camps to keep Wukong P Stone Skin stacks active. Save Wukong R Cyclone for the next fight and objective fights instead of using it on camps.
Udyr.phase: Wukong's early clear speed and damage are average, so look for gains with early ganks. In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Udyr.teamfight: Don't focus Udyr first when he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle. After Udyr E Blazing Stampede's stun and Awakened effect are down, coordinate with your allies' crowd control and use Wukong E Nimbus Strike to reach a vulnerable enemy in the back line, then knock up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone. Follow with Wukong W Warrior Trickster to add the clone's Wukong R Cyclone and avoid retaliation.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede closes in quickly and stuns, so don't approach right after he activates a stance. During Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect, immobilizing effects don't work, so use Wukong R Cyclone after it ends. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on maximum health, so don't rely on health alone to survive.

Vi.build: Build armor first against Vi's main damage. Vi W Denting Blows reduces your armor and deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on a large health increase alone. Her damage relies on basic attacks and attack speed, so consider ways to reduce her attack speed as well.
Vi.combo: After Vi Q Vault Breaker is down, use Wukong E Nimbus Strike to close in and activate Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash. Land an empowered basic attack as you arrive, and use Wukong R Cyclone if Vi's main crowd control is down. Follow with Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics the ultimate while Wukong turns invisible and avoids retaliation.
Vi.escape: Right after Vi uses Vi Q Vault Breaker, you have a window to close the distance with Wukong W Warrior Trickster or Wukong E Nimbus Strike. If Vi R Cease and Desist is still available, don't rush Wukong R Cyclone; look for an opportunity after Vi's landing and knockup have finished.
Vi.fight: Trade briefly right after dodging or baiting out Vi Q Vault Breaker. Use Wukong E Nimbus Strike to close in and land an empowered basic attack, then use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to create distance instead of trading long enough for Vi W Denting Blows to stack. If Vi's shield is active, wait for it to be removed before trading.
Vi.laning: In the jungle, chain camps to keep Wukong P Stone Skin stacks from expiring. You can attack a nearby jungle monster just before a fight to build stacks. Look for an opening when Vi Q Vault Breaker is down, and save Wukong R Cyclone for fights instead of camps.
Vi.phase: Look for early gains with Wukong's early ganks. In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Vi.teamfight: After Vi Q Vault Breaker and Vi R Cease and Desist are down, use Wukong E Nimbus Strike to close in and spin Wukong R Cyclone when two or more enemies group together. Coordinate your entry with your allies' crowd control, and move toward the group while Cyclone is active. Follow with Wukong W Warrior Trickster to leave a clone that continues the ultimate while invisible Wukong avoids retaliation.
Vi.watch: When Vi charges Vi Q Vault Breaker, dodge by moving backward or to the side. Vi R Cease and Desist follows its target to the end, so don't try to dodge it with Flash. If Vi hits you repeatedly, Vi W Denting Blows reduces your armor and increases her attack speed, so avoid extended trades.

Viego.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. If the duel goes long, consider healing reduction next to counter the healing from Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King also deals damage based on current health, so be cautious about relying on a large health increase alone.
Viego.combo: When Viego W Spectral Maw and Viego R Heartbreaker are down, use Wukong E Nimbus Strike to engage and activate Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash. Land an empowered basic attack as you arrive, knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone, then follow with Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone also uses Wukong R Cyclone. Wukong moves while invisible to avoid retaliation.
Viego.escape: Don't rush in when only Viego W Spectral Maw is down, because Viego can escape with Viego R Heartbreaker. When both of his mobility abilities are down, especially before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back, you have an opportunity to close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and use Wukong R Cyclone.
Viego.fight: Use Wukong E Nimbus Strike to close in after both Viego W Spectral Maw and Viego R Heartbreaker are down. In a small skirmish you can't win, back off without giving up a kill.
Viego.laning: Don't push the lane toward the side where Viego E Harrowed Path is visible. Place a Control Ward or take a route around it. In the jungle, chain camps to keep Wukong P Stone Skin stacks active; you can attack a nearby jungle monster just before a fight to build stacks. Save Wukong R Cyclone for the next fight instead of using it on camps.
Viego.phase: Wukong's early clear speed and damage are average, so look for gains with early ganks. In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage. At any stage, avoid giving Viego a kill.
Viego.teamfight: Check that Viego W Spectral Maw is down, then engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and Wukong R Cyclone when two or more enemies group together, coordinating with your allies' crowd control. Move toward the enemies while Wukong R Cyclone is active, then immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to add the clone's Wukong R Cyclone. When an ally dies, push Viego away or lock him down so he can't possess them, and don't keep fighting at that spot.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the more it is charged. Dodge to the side when you see him charge it, and interrupt it with Wukong R Cyclone before it hits. If Viego E Harrowed Path covers terrain, watch for Viego camouflaged inside it. When your health is low, fall back because you may be targeted by Viego R Heartbreaker.

Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. If Warwick's healing becomes a problem in a long duel, add healing reduction with Executioner's Calling after you have some resistance.
Warwick.combo: When Warwick's mobility and crowd control are down, dash in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and activate Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash to land an empowered basic attack as you arrive. Follow with basic attacks, then use Wukong R Cyclone to knock him up and immediately cast Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone also spins the ultimate. While invisible, Wukong can dodge Warwick's retaliation and reposition.
Warwick.escape: When engaging, don't assume it's enough that only Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down. Look for a window when Warwick R Infinite Duress is not back yet and Warwick E Primal Howl's fear has already triggered, then close in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike. Use Wukong R Cyclone to leave Warwick less room to escape.
Warwick.fight: When Warwick E Primal Howl is active, don't commit all your damage; trade after the fear triggers. When Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast and Warwick R Infinite Duress are down, use Wukong E Nimbus Strike to close in and follow with an empowered basic attack and more attacks. Warwick heals more when below half health, so don't chase deeply or dive based on his health alone.
Warwick.laning: Chain jungle camps to keep Wukong P Stone Skin stacks from expiring, and you can attack a jungle monster just before a fight to build stacks. If your health drops below half, Warwick can detect your location, so recall even if you have to give up some farm.
Warwick.phase: Wukong's early clear speed and damage are average, but Warwick also clears the jungle slowly, so Wukong can gain an advantage with early ganks and jungle invades. In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing duel damage to Warwick.
Warwick.teamfight: After Warwick E Primal Howl and Warwick R Infinite Duress are down, use Wukong E Nimbus Strike to engage when two or more enemies group together, coordinating with your allies' crowd control. Move while spinning Wukong R Cyclone to knock up multiple enemies, then immediately use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to add the clone's Wukong R Cyclone. If an ally is caught by Warwick R Infinite Duress, focus your retaliation while Warwick is locked in place to save them.
Warwick.watch: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and triggers fear, so use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to create distance and re-engage after the fear. If caught by Warwick R Infinite Duress, you can act until the suppression ends, so watch for long-range engages from areas without vision. When your health drops below half, Warwick can detect your location and gains movement speed and attack speed.

XinZhao.build: Build armor first against Xin Zhao's main damage. Since he relies on basic attacks and attack speed, reducing his attack speed is also effective. Armor won't stop the magic damage from Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, and considering Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard, relying on a large health increase alone is inefficient.
XinZhao.combo: When Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down, dash in with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and activate Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash to land an empowered basic attack as you arrive. Follow with basic attacks, then use Wukong W Warrior Trickster immediately after Wukong R Cyclone knocks him up so the clone also spins the ultimate. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, don't expect Wukong R Cyclone to damage him from outside the spear's range.
XinZhao.escape: Right after Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down, you have a window to close the distance with Wukong W Warrior Trickster or Wukong E Nimbus Strike. Engage with Wukong R Cyclone after dodging Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike's third hit and Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard's knockback, or confirming they are down.
XinZhao.fight: After baiting out Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, use Wukong E Nimbus Strike to close in. Reduce his armor with Wukong Q Crushing Blow, then keep attacking to make use of Wukong E Nimbus Strike's attack speed increase. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, don't unload damage from outside the spear's range; retaliate after the immunity ends.
XinZhao.laning: Chain camps to keep Wukong P Stone Skin stacks active, and attack a nearby jungle monster just before a fight to build stacks. Don't waste Wukong Q Crushing Blow on a camp; save it for the fight with Xin Zhao. Save Wukong R Cyclone for fights instead of clearing camps, and if you are not ready, limit your objective play to securing vision.
XinZhao.phase: Wukong's early clear speed and damage are average, so look for gains with early ganks. In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage, and use the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends as an opportunity to retaliate.
XinZhao.teamfight: When Xin Zhao engages, Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard's knockback can split your formation, so don't stand too close to allies. After Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard's crowd control are down, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and Wukong R Cyclone when two or more enemies group together, coordinating with your allies' crowd control. Follow with Wukong W Warrior Trickster to leave the clone's Wukong R Cyclone and turn invisible to avoid retaliation.
XinZhao.watch: Dodge the later thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving to the side. Dodging the thrust also prevents him from Challenging you and extending Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge's range. If Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike has hit you twice with empowered basic attacks, use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to get out of range before the third hit knocks you up.

Zac.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Zac's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance before armor.
Zac.combo: When Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down, use Wukong E Nimbus Strike to close in and activate Wukong Q Crushing Blow during the dash. Land an empowered basic attack as you arrive, knock him up with Wukong R Cyclone, then follow with Wukong W Warrior Trickster so the clone mimics the ultimate. If you see Zac charging Zac E Elastic Slingshot and are within range, interrupt the charge with Wukong R Cyclone.
Zac.escape: Engage after Zac E Elastic Slingshot and Zac Q Stretching Strikes' crowd control are down. In particular, right after Zac uses Zac E Elastic Slingshot, you have a window to close in with Wukong W Warrior Trickster or Wukong E Nimbus Strike and use Wukong R Cyclone.
Zac.fight: Close the distance and fight right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down. During the fight, step on Zac's blobs to prevent him from healing.
Zac.laning: Early on, watch out for Zac's magic damage, build magic resistance, and look for early gank opportunities. Chain jungle camps to keep Wukong P Stone Skin stacks active, and save Wukong R Cyclone for fights instead of clearing camps.
Zac.phase: Early on, Wukong is vulnerable to Zac's magic damage, so build a way to withstand it first and look for gains with early ganks. In the late game, focus on knocking up multiple enemies with Wukong R Cyclone rather than dealing damage.
Zac.teamfight: After Zac Q Stretching Strikes and Zac E Elastic Slingshot's crowd control are down, engage with Wukong E Nimbus Strike and Wukong R Cyclone when two or more enemies group together, coordinating with your allies' engage. Immediately follow Wukong R Cyclone with Wukong W Warrior Trickster to extend the spin with the clone and avoid retaliation.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot charges before dashing in and knocking you up, so watch for an engage if you see him charging behind a wall. Also beware of the crowd control from Zac Q Stretching Strikes and the maximum-health-based damage from Zac W Unstable Matter. Step on Zac's blobs to prevent him from healing.
